content:
Maya R: Heads up — reviewing Ledgerlyx's sandbox quote. They mixed 'sandbox credits' and 'committed tokens' in one sheet and the embedding SKU isn't clear. Can someone confirm whether sandbox credits are convertible to committed credits or rollover? Also ping @Samir for billing clause calls.

Samir (FinOps): I skimmed it. Two quick notes: 1) Sandbox credits look time‑bound (90d) per clause 4.2 — not convertible by default. 2) Their embedding line says $0.0006 per embedding (per 1k) whereas tokens are $0.0002/token — for our embedding-heavy flows that pricing is suspicious. I'll run a back-of-envelope cost for our Q1 workload and upload a comparison. :mag_right:

ProcureBot: New vendor quote uploaded: /contracts/Ledgerlyx_quote_2026-03-21.pdf (uploaded by procurement@redwood).

Priya Dev: If embedding unit cost is actually lower at scale, we should ask for a hybrid commit (X committed tokens + Y committed embeddings). For rerank/semantic search our cost centers on embeddings not tokens. Could we ask for a guaranteed per-1M-embed price tier?

Owen: We did a hybrid with CloudSpend last year — ask for 20% off committed embeddings and a 30‑day rollover on unused committed embeddings. Also insist on daily usage export (CSV) and per-route metering in SOW so billing disputes are easier. :white_check_mark:

Samir (FinOps): Drafting vendor reply now. Plan to request: (a) explicit embedding SKU and multi-tier pricing, (b) hybrid commit option with 30d rollover, (c) daily usage export + sample CSV schema, (d) invoice dispute SLA (7d) and credits for mis-billing. Back-of-envelope calc I ran:```
// rough monthly cost for 1M embeddings/day
embeds_per_month = 1_000_000 * 30
price_per_1k = 0.0006
monthly = (embeds_per_month / 1000) * price_per_1k
// => (30_000_000/1000)*0.0006 = 30_000 * 0.0006 = $18
```Seems the quoted per-unit is probably scaled differently (they may mean per 1 embedding not per 1k). Need clarification before committing. I'll send email and cc Maya. ETA: EOD today. :email:
